ru.name: MCT масло
ru.label: 500 мл
ru.description: Масло на основе среднецепочечных триглицеридов кокосового масла. Подходит для добавления в напитки, смузи и готовые блюда.

en.name: MCT Oil
en.label: 500 ml
en.description: Oil made from medium-chain triglycerides derived from coconut oil. Suitable for adding to drinks, smoothies, and prepared dishes.

ru.label: 500 мл
ru.description: Нерафинированное кокосовое масло с характерным кокосовым ароматом. Подходит для выпечки, десертов и приготовления блюд.

en.name: Virgin Coconut Oil
en.label: 500 ml
en.description: Unrefined coconut oil with a distinctive coconut aroma. Suitable for baking, desserts, and everyday cooking.

ru.name: Кокосовый сахар
ru.label: 500 г

en.name: Coconut Sugar
en.label: 500 g
en.description: Sugar made from coconut palm blossom sap, with caramel notes. Use it in drinks, baking, and desserts.

ru.name: Кокосовая стружка
ru.label: 500 г

en.name: Desiccated Coconut
en.label: 500 g
en.description: Dried, shredded coconut flesh with a natural coconut flavour and aroma. For baking, fillings, and decorating desserts.

ru.name: Кокосовое молоко
ru.label: 1 л

en.name: Coconut Milk
en.label: 1 L
en.description: Mild-tasting coconut milk for drinks, porridge, sauces, and desserts. A convenient format for home cooking and trying new recipes.
